{{Quote|Time to join the Force, Jedi!|Smug|<ref name="Wookiee Hunt">{{TCW|Wookiee Hunt}}</ref>}}
'''Smug''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who was a part of a Trandoshan group that kidnapped beings or [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitives]] and then hunt them down for sport during the tie of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Some of the prisoners that had taken refuge in [[Island Four/Legends|Island Four]], including [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], had become a threat to the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] slavers on [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]]. They sent two scouts, Smug and [[Krix/Legends|Krix]], to hunt them down. Smug eventually found [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] in the crash site of a Trandoshan prisoner transport. He nearly shot them both with a sniper rifle, but missed. He was later apprehended by the two other remaining Jedi, [[Jinx/Legends|Jinx]] and [[O-Mer/Legends|O-Mer]]. They took him prisoner. The next morning, Jinx employed a [[Mind trick/Legends|Mind trick]] on him and had him call a [[MSP80 Pteropter hover pod/Legends|speeder]] to pick them up. When Krix arrived, the prisoners managed to knock both Krix and Smug unconscious and then hijack the speeder.
